title: 16 arrested during anti-lockdown protest in south London
reason: Below the 50-person threshold as reported: the opened LBC article says about 30 people marched down Clapham High Street.
notes: This is a separate London action from the 6 January Parliament Square demonstration and the separately mentioned Westminster Magistrates’ Court gathering. StandupX organized the Clapham march; it began shortly after midday, moved toward Stockwell, returned to Clapham Common and was dispersed by police. LBC reports a main 16-arrest count and quotes an earlier Met post reporting 12 arrested “so far”; preserve both rather than treating the interim count as the final count. Twenty-two fixed-penalty notices are not attendance.
